implementationDecisions.variantSets: Five sets by type, 18 variants each; type is selected by set, preserving all 90 observed combinations.
implementationDecisions.loadingWidth: Keep source HUG geometry; document stable-width requirement as consumer responsibility, not as an implemented web guarantee.
implementationDecisions.scope: Figma and contract/consumption only; React implementation and service-backed actions are outside this pilot.
